# coval_agent (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval agent by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_agent" "support" {
  id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Agent ID.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Dynamic) Free-form JSON agent attributes.
- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `customer_agent_id` (String) Customer-defined external identifier.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable agent name.
- `endpoint` (String) Webhook endpoint URL.
- `knowledge_base_ids` (Set of String) Associated knowledge-base entry IDs.
- `language` (String) Primary language for the agent.
- `metadata` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Simulator-specific JSON configuration.
- `metric_ids` (Set of String) Associated metric IDs.
- `model_type` (String) Agent simulator type.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number or SIP address.
- `prompt` (String) Agent instructions or system prompt.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the agent.
- `test_set_ids` (Set of String) Associated test-set IDs.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.
- `workflows` (Dynamic) Workflow JSON configuration.
